clues: This city in Iran stands on the banks of the Karun River. It lies near the border with Iraq, close to the Persian Gulf.
Summers here are long and fiercely hot, and dust storms are common. In June 2017, this city set its hottest mark ever seen.
In old times, this city was a chief home of the Academy of Gondishapur. That famed school was a light of learning in the old world.
Folk call this the City of Bridges, for its many big spans. The spans cross the wide river to link its east and west halves.
Since the start of the last century, this city has been known as the Oil Capital of Iran. Oil made its name across the whole land.
